title: Clue Hunting Removal
acceptance: No landmark shows an Investigate prompt. Nothing writes `journal.clues` or sets `shortcut`, `bellHint` or `bellClue`. There is no server eject loop.

Crypt entry and Bell Wraith capture follow the rule jg approves in ADR-0007. The Bell Wraith spawns without any clue, is visible to everyone, and keeps `maxAlive = 1`. Ashen still rolls only in the Crypt zone.
The west shortcut is open without a flag, and the first ride gives no bell clue or toast.
Monster highlight and name markers appear for species the player has inspected (`journal.seen`).
The journal still lists species and variants. The Clues card, the landmark counter and the Grave Scholar trophy are gone.

The tutorial keeps 12 steps and none needs an investigation (step 3 explore, step 12 the rare's lair). Saved step numbers keep their meaning, and the skip-forward checks still prevent it from blocking play.
A profile containing `journal.clues` and the three old flags sanitizes without loss (spec).
The specs plus FullLoop, Reachability, ExploitProbe and CrossPlot (2 players) pass in Studio. LandmarkStart is retired.
